# The Connections

> The Connections is an India-based business process outsourcing (BPO) and operations partner. Its primary focus is cross-industry BPO services, complemented by specialist healthcare operations support.

## Core positioning

- Primary offering (approximately 70% of the service portfolio): BPO solutions for customer experience, contact centres, customer care, omnichannel communication, customer acquisition, back-office support, invoice and AMC management, data management, database analytics, market research, surveys, sales leakage analysis, VIP account management and startup operations.
- Specialist offering (approximately 30% of the service portfolio): healthcare operations including medical billing, medical coding, revenue cycle management, credentialing, eligibility verification, prior and prescription authorization, claims, denial management, payment posting, accounts receivable and patient support.
- Industries served include financial services, e-commerce and retail, telecommunications, travel and hospitality, education, automotive, real estate, pharmaceuticals and medical devices.
- Delivery locations: Pune, Bengaluru and Ahmedabad, India.
- Service area: global.
